test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 12 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Rubi and Juhi are sisters. Krishna is Juhi's father's father. Reshma is the mother of Arvind. Arvind is the father of Rohit, who is the only brother of Rubi. How is Krishna related to Rohit?
solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbols,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4cdd0b30cffaf954e65ff899730e11e9e4ceb2b8a3106f0f1cf7dc6cc2718c84.png] 

We can dram following Family Tree from the information given above:

1) Rubi and Juhi are sisters.

2) Krishna is Juhi’s father's father.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/66ef193f561145d75d04ae4333b34241f30e191955903d002562ba8c795a6a9b.png] 

3) Arvind is the father of Rohit, who is the only brother of Rubi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c0cc07e447abfb928eb93c146c4ebf11ada16b7f8abe209befec9a0a5f87c9b.png] 

4) Reshma is the mother of Arvind.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f31f7403f51394917a6dc4b863c185322e665dc990e1993b8d2ca4161240720c.png] 

Hence, Krishna is **"Father's father"** of Rohit.
